preConditions.onFailMessage: booking dev seed edge cases skipped: seeded items 910100002-910100008 were edited or are missing
preConditions.onErrorMessage: booking dev seed edge cases skipped: seeded items 910100002-910100008 could not be checked
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BookingConfiguration WHERE openingStart = '00:00' AND openingEnd = '24:00' AND openDays = '[1,2,3,4,5,6,7]' AND openingExceptions = '[]' AND slotGranularityMinutes = 5 AND ((id = 910100002 AND timeZone = 'Europe/Berlin') OR (id IN (910100003, 910100004) AND timeZone = 'UTC') OR (id IN (910100005, 910100006) AND timeZone = 'America/New_York') OR (id IN (910100007, 910100008) AND timeZone = 'Asia/Singapore'))

changeSet.comment: Turn the fresh dev booking seed into an edge-case catalogue: give items 910100002-910100008 partial opening hours, closed weekdays, per-weekday exceptions and unusual time zones, and add a few events that sit on those boundaries. Runs only while all seven items still have the seed's all-day, every-day defaults, so it never overwrites a developer's edits. Item 910100001 (double booking, all day) is left unchanged. Raw SQL bypasses Envers, so no _AUD rows are written, as with the original seed.
